Title of Research: Improving acceptability of mHealth apps – The use of TAM: Systematic review
Methodology: Systematic review of TAM-based mHealth studies
Result: Perceived usefulness and ease of use remain strongest predictors of mHealth adoption
Contribution to Knowledge: Validated TAM as the dominant framework for mHealth acceptability assessment
Research Gap / Limitation: Did not examine offline-specific design factors; limited to English-language studies

Title of Research: Assessment of barriers and enablers of mHealth in Sub-Saharan Africa
Methodology: Qualitative study; semi-structured interviews with patients, physicians, executives in Ethiopia
Result: Identified 137 determinants of mHealth adoption; lack of local digital health systems and interoperability as key barriers
Contribution to Knowledge: Multi-stakeholder perspective on mHealth adoption barriers in SSA
Research Gap / Limitation: Ethiopian context only; may not generalize to all SSA countries

Title of Research: mHealth in SSA and Europe: A systematic review
Methodology: Systematic review (Scopus, WoS, IEEE, PubMed); PRISMA 2020
Result: Significant gaps in mHealth maturity between SSA and Europe; most SSA systems remain at pilot stage
Contribution to Knowledge: First comparative review of mHealth readiness between SSA and Europe
Research Gap / Limitation: English-language articles only; potential publication bias

Title of Research: The health workforce status in the WHO African Region
Methodology: Cross-sectional study; 47 WHO African Member States
Result: Physician/nurse/midwife density of 1.55 per 1,000; 6.1 million shortfalls projected by 2030
Contribution to Knowledge: Definitive regional health workforce baseline for the African continent
Research Gap / Limitation: Aggregated national data may mask sub-national disparities

Title of Research: An empirical evaluation of the System Usability Scale
Methodology: Empirical analysis of ~10 years of SUS data across multiple products
Result: SUS reliability ≥0.90 in large samples; adjective rating scale proposed (85+ = Excellent, <70 = Poor)
Contribution to Knowledge: Validated SUS as reliable and provided interpretive benchmarks
Research Gap / Limitation: Data primarily from technology products, not healthcare-specific applications

Title of Research: The burden of polypharmacy and potentially inappropriate medication in Nigeria
Methodology: Systematic literature review of Nigerian polypharmacy studies
Result: 25–35% of older Nigerians experience polypharmacy; PIM prevalence 25.5–57.6%
Contribution to Knowledge: First synthesis of polypharmacy burden specifically in Nigeria
Research Gap / Limitation: Literature predominantly from South-Western Nigeria

Title of Research: SUS: A ‘quick and dirty’ usability scale
Methodology: 10-item Likert-scale instrument development; selected from pool of 50 items
Result: Composite usability score (0–100) with strong inter-item correlations (r = 0.7–0.9)
Contribution to Knowledge: Created the most widely used standardized usability questionnaire
Research Gap / Limitation: Original work lacked formal reliability/validity analysis

Title of Research: Perceived usefulness, perceived ease of use, and user acceptance of IT
Methodology: Theoretical model development and empirical validation
Result: Perceived usefulness and ease of use significantly predict technology adoption
Contribution to Knowledge: Established the Technology Acceptance Model – foundational IT adoption framework
Research Gap / Limitation: Original validation in workplace IT; generalizability to health contexts requires extension

Title of Research: A multimodal deep learning framework for predicting DDI events
Methodology: Multimodal deep learning integrating chemical, target, enzyme, pathway features
Result: Accuracy: 88.5%; AUPR: 0.92 across 65 DDI event categories
Contribution to Knowledge: Demonstrated that pharmacological multi-modality improves DDI prediction accuracy
Research Gap / Limitation: Computationally expensive; not designed for mobile deployment

Title of Research: Integrating digital health technologies into healthcare in Nigeria
Methodology: Scoping review; PubMed, Scopus, WoS, CINAHL, Google Scholar (2014–2024); 31 studies
Result: DHTs enhanced adherence and utilization; poor connectivity and financial constraints persist
Contribution to Knowledge: Comprehensive mapping of digital health integration challenges in Nigeria
Research Gap / Limitation: Potential publication bias; exclusion of grey literature

Title of Research: An analysis of pharmacy workforce capacity in Nigeria
Methodology: Census-based analysis using PCN data (2011–2016)
Result: 21,892 registered pharmacists; only 59% in active practice; density 0.53–0.66 per 10,000
Contribution to Knowledge: Definitive pharmacy workforce baseline for Nigeria
Research Gap / Limitation: Population data based on 2006 census estimates

Title of Research: Override rate of DDI alerts in CDSS: Systematic review and meta-analysis
Methodology: Meta-analysis of 16 studies; >570,000 prescriptions
Result: ~90% DDI alert override rate (95% CI: 85–95%)
Contribution to Knowledge: Quantified the severity of alert fatigue in DDI alerting systems
Research Gap / Limitation: Heterogeneous study designs limited pooled analysis

Title of Research: Towards effective clinical decision support systems
Methodology: Systematic review; 52 CDSS studies (2000–2020); PRISMA
Result: Most CDSS do not exceed maturity level 2; “choice” and “implementation” phases underrepresented
Contribution to Knowledge: Developed a CDSS Maturity Staging Model based on Simon’s decision theory
Research Gap / Limitation: Only open-access articles included

Title of Research: Design science in information systems research
Methodology: Theoretical framework development; seven DSR guidelines
Result: Established guidelines for building and evaluating IS artefacts
Contribution to Knowledge: Foundational DSR framework for information systems
Research Gap / Limitation: Broad framework; requires operationalization for specific domains

Title of Research: Preventable medication harm across health care settings
Methodology: Systematic review and meta-analysis; 81 studies; 285,687 patients
Result: Pooled preventable harm prevalence ≈3%; >25% severe/life-threatening; prescribing errors 58%
Contribution to Knowledge: Most comprehensive quantification of preventable medication harm globally
Research Gap / Limitation: Systematic underreporting likely understates true burden

Title of Research: Effect of electronic DDI alerts on patient and clinician outcomes
Methodology: Systematic review; MEDLINE, EMBASE, CINAHL, Cochrane; 8 studies; 43,413 patients
Result: CDSS-DI is ubiquitous but impact on patient outcomes remains unproven
Contribution to Knowledge: First systematic review focused specifically on DDI alert patient outcomes
Research Gap / Limitation: Most studies had high risk of bias; heterogeneous outcomes

Title of Research: Prevalence of DDIs in older community-dwelling individuals
Methodology: Systematic review and meta-analysis; 31 studies
Result: Pooled DDI prevalence: 28.8% (95% CI: 19.3–40.7%)
Contribution to Knowledge: Established pooled DDI prevalence estimates for older adults
Research Gap / Limitation: Heterogeneous DDI definitions across included studies

Title of Research: Medication safety alert fatigue: Systematic review
Methodology: Systematic review; PubMed, Embase, CINAHL, Cochrane (2007–2017)
Result: Modal pop-ups least accepted; pharmacist-mediated advice most accepted CDS design
Contribution to Knowledge: Identified tiered alerts and role-based routing as alert fatigue mitigation strategies
Research Gap / Limitation: Heterogeneity precluded meta-analysis; academic medical centre bias

Title of Research: Barriers and facilitators for sustainability of digital health interventions in LMICs
Methodology: Systematic review; Frontiers in Digital Health
Result: Five dominant barriers: infrastructure, connectivity, electricity, equipment, design limitations
Contribution to Knowledge: Synthesized sustainability barriers specific to LMIC digital health contexts
Research Gap / Limitation: Predominantly SSA studies; limited generalizability to other LMIC regions

Title of Research: A comparison of five common DDI software programs
Methodology: Cross-sectional evaluation; 400 drug pairs; sensitivity, specificity, accuracy
Result: Lexi-Interact and Epocrates scored highest accuracy (250/400 each)
Contribution to Knowledge: Demonstrated that combining multiple DDI resources improves sensitivity
Research Gap / Limitation: Iranian pharmacy setting; software versions from 2013

Title of Research: DrugBank 6.0: The DrugBank Knowledgebase for 2024
Methodology: Database description and update report
Result: ~17,000 drug entries; ~2.6 million DDI entries; expanded target and pathway data
Contribution to Knowledge: Definitive reference for the DrugBank knowledge base
Research Gap / Limitation: Coverage of non-Western marketed drugs may be incomplete

Title of Research: Agile software development in healthcare: A synthetic scoping review
Methodology: Scoping review; 224 papers; Scopus, WoS; bibliometric + thematic analysis
Result: ASD improves software quality and reduces development resources in healthcare
Contribution to Knowledge: First large-scale synthesis of agile methods in healthcare software
Research Gap / Limitation: Only two databases used; possible exclusion of grey literature

Title of Research: Effectiveness of mobile apps on medication adherence: Systematic review and meta-analysis
Methodology: Systematic review and meta-analysis; RCTs from MEDLINE, Embase, Cochrane
Result: mHealth apps significantly improved medication adherence vs. standard care
Contribution to Knowledge: Meta-analytic evidence for mHealth effectiveness in chronic disease adherence
Research Gap / Limitation: Reliance on self-reported adherence measures; study heterogeneity

Title of Research: Implementation of digital monitoring services during COVID-19: DSR approach
Methodology: Design science research applied to digital health monitoring
Result: Demonstrated DSR applicability for rapid digital health solution development
Contribution to Knowledge: Validated DSR methodology in a real-world digital health implementation context
Research Gap / Limitation: COVID-19-specific context; generalizability to non-pandemic settings uncertain

Title of Research: DGNN-DDI: A dual GNN for DDI prediction based on molecular structure
Methodology: Dual graph neural network with co-attention mechanism
Result: Outperformed SSI-DDI, GMPNN-CS, SA-DDI on DrugBank dataset
Contribution to Knowledge: Identified key molecular substructures contributing to DDI predictions
Research Gap / Limitation: Chemical structure only; no pharmacological or biological features incorporated

Title of Research: Design and development of mobile healthcare app prototype using Flutter
Methodology: Prototype development; Flutter framework; telemedicine app
Result: Demonstrated Flutter’s suitability for rapid healthcare app prototyping
Contribution to Knowledge: Validated Flutter as viable for cross-platform healthcare mobile development
Research Gap / Limitation: Prototype only; no formal usability evaluation; Android-only testing

Title of Research: Umbrella review of contributory factors to medication errors
Methodology: Umbrella review; 27 systematic reviews; Medline, CINAHL, Embase, Google Scholar
Result: Decision-making mistakes most common proximal cause; organizational factors dominant systemically
Contribution to Knowledge: First umbrella review synthesizing medication error contributory factors across all settings
Research Gap / Limitation: Only 10/27 reviews used pre-specified error classification methodology

Title of Research: Medication errors among health professionals in Nigeria
Methodology: Cross-sectional national survey; 2,386 health professionals; 10 tertiary hospitals
Result: Self-reported medication error prevalence of 47%
Contribution to Knowledge: First national-scale medication error survey in Nigeria
Research Gap / Limitation: Self-reporting likely underestimates actual error rates; tertiary hospitals only

Title of Research: Adoption of digital health technology in Nigeria: A scoping review
Methodology: Scoping review; 230 studies (2010–2024); Arksey & O’Malley; PRISMA-ScR
Result: mHealth largest focus (23.9%); practical application limited by infrastructure deficits
Contribution to Knowledge: Most comprehensive mapping of digital health research trends in Nigeria
Research Gap / Limitation: Published literature only; grey literature excluded

Title of Research: Potential DDIs in pediatric outpatient prescriptions in Nigeria
Methodology: Prospective clinical audit; 4 general hospitals; 3-month period; 1,233 patients
Result: 16.9% of patients received prescriptions with ≥1 potential DDI; most major/moderate
Contribution to Knowledge: First prospective DDI audit in Nigerian pediatric outpatient settings
Research Gap / Limitation: Outpatient settings and pediatric populations only

Title of Research: Evaluation of resources for analyzing drug interactions
Methodology: Cross-sectional study; 100 interaction pairs across 7 resources
Result: Lexicomp and Clinical Pharmacology scored 97% scope; Micromedex highest completeness
Contribution to Knowledge: Comparative baseline for DDI resource evaluation
Research Gap / Limitation: Convenience sample of 100 interactions; subjective scoring scales

Title of Research: Polypharmacy in older adults: Narrative review of definitions and consequences
Methodology: Narrative review; MEDLINE (2015–2020)
Result: 143 definitions of polypharmacy identified; prevalence 4–96.5% depending on setting
Contribution to Knowledge: Highlighted the problematic heterogeneity in polypharmacy definitions
Research Gap / Limitation: Narrative review; MEDLINE only

Title of Research: A design science research methodology for IS research
Methodology: Methodology development; six-activity DSR process model
Result: Structured DSR into problem identification, objectives, design, demonstration, evaluation, communication
Contribution to Knowledge: Created the most widely adopted DSR process model
Research Gap / Limitation: Broad methodology; requires adaptation for specific project contexts

Title of Research: DeepARV: Ensemble deep learning for DDI severity classification
Methodology: Ensemble deep learning (ChemBERTa + RF baselines); 4 severity classes
Result: Best weighted balanced accuracy: 0.776 ± 0.011
Contribution to Knowledge: Demonstrated ML-based multi-class DDI severity classification is feasible
Research Gap / Limitation: ARV drugs only; class imbalance challenges

Title of Research: FAERS Essentials: Guide to understanding and interpreting FAERS data
Methodology: Descriptive/guidance paper; FDA-authored
Result: Described FAERS content, application, limitations; documented openFDA API
Contribution to Knowledge: Authoritative reference for FAERS data interpretation and openFDA access
Research Gap / Limitation: Guidance paper; no empirical study component

Title of Research: How to reload and upgrade digital health to serve Nigeria
Methodology: Perspective/review of Nigeria’s digital health landscape
Result: >100 ICT-for-health initiatives; 74.7% out-of-pocket health expenditure; 1.95 HW per 1,000
Contribution to Knowledge: Documented fragmentation and infrastructure barriers in Nigerian digital health
Research Gap / Limitation: Perspective paper; not systematic empirical methodology

Title of Research: PK and PD DDIs: Research methods and applications
Methodology: Comprehensive review of DDI evaluation methodologies
Result: Most DDI studies evaluate from single PK or PD perspective, causing evaluation errors
Contribution to Knowledge: Unified review of both PK and PD DDI evaluation methods including ML approaches
Research Gap / Limitation: Methodologically focused; no novel empirical data

Title of Research: An overview of CDSS: Benefits, risks, and strategies for success
Methodology: Narrative review; npj Digital Medicine
Result: CDSS effective for drug checking, diagnosis, reminders; alert fatigue and automation bias persist
Contribution to Knowledge: State-of-the-art CDSS overview distinguishing knowledge-based from ML-based systems
Research Gap / Limitation: Narrative review; primarily covers high-income healthcare settings

Title of Research: Comparison of tertiary drug resources for adjunctive analgesic DDIs
Methodology: Comparative analysis; Micromedex, Lexicomp, Medscape; 6 drug combinations
Result: Significant severity rating discrepancies across platforms for same drug pairs
Contribution to Knowledge: Exposed heterogeneity in DDI severity classification across major platforms
Research Gap / Limitation: Small number of drug pairs; pain management context only

Title of Research: Comprehensive review of ML-based DDI prediction
Methodology: Systematic review; J. Chem. Inf. Model.
Result: Data imbalance, lack of standardized benchmarks, and limited interpretability are key challenges
Contribution to Knowledge: Comprehensive taxonomy of ML approaches and evaluation methodology for DDI prediction
Research Gap / Limitation: Review only; no novel model contribution

Title of Research: RxNorm for drug name normalization: Prescription opioids in FAERS
Methodology: Case study; RxNorm API mapping of opioids in FAERS
Result: 2,086 different names mapped to 92 RxNorm concepts across 14.9 million reports
Contribution to Knowledge: Demonstrated RxNorm API efficiency for drug name normalization at scale
Research Gap / Limitation: Opioids only; broader drug class validation needed

Title of Research: RxBERT: Enhancing drug labelling text mining with AI
Methodology: BERT-based LM pre-trained on FDA drug labels; NER and classification tasks
Result: F1: 86.5 (NER); Accuracy: 87% (sentence classification)
Contribution to Knowledge: Domain-specific language model for FDA drug label mining
Research Gap / Limitation: GPU-intensive; not mobile-deployable; pre-training/evaluation data overlap

Title of Research: Comprehensive review of deep learning for DDI prediction
Methodology: Systematic review; Briefings in Functional Genomics
Result: Graph-based DL outperforms traditional ML; cold-start problem persists
Contribution to Knowledge: Classified DL approaches into sequence-based, graph-based, and hybrid architectures
Research Gap / Limitation: Review only; does not address mobile deployment feasibility

Title of Research: SumGNN: Multi-typed DDI prediction via KG summarization
Methodology: GNN with attention-based knowledge graph summarization
Result: F1 improvement up to 5.54% over existing KG-based methods on DrugBank/TWOSIDES
Contribution to Knowledge: Introduced interpretable reasoning paths for DDI prediction
Research Gap / Limitation: Computational cost scales poorly with very large knowledge graphs

Title of Research: EmerGNN: Emerging drug interaction prediction with flow-based GNN
Methodology: Flow-based GNN on biomedical network; cold-start evaluation
Result: Significantly outperformed existing methods for newly approved drug DDI prediction
Contribution to Knowledge: First approach specifically targeting the DDI cold-start problem with GNN
Research Gap / Limitation: Requires large biomedical knowledge graph; not mobile-deployable

Title of Research: DDI prediction: Databases, web servers, and computational models
Methodology: Comprehensive review; Briefings in Bioinformatics
Result: Detailed comparison of DDI databases (DrugBank, DDInter, SIDER, TWOSIDES) and ML models
Contribution to Knowledge: Definitive comparative reference for DDI databases and computational prediction tools
Research Gap / Limitation: Focuses on prediction rather than clinical workflow integration
